title: MongoDB Driver
description: The official MongoDB driver for .NET, enabling document database operations.

data.text: The MongoDB .NET Driver provides asynchronous access to MongoDB databases. It enables you to store, query, and update BSON documents using strongly-typed C# classes.

data.title: Basic CRUD Operations
data.content: Connect to MongoDB and perform CRUD operations.

terms.definition: The main entry point for connecting to a MongoDB deployment.
Represents a MongoDB collection and provides access to documents.
A strongly-typed filter for querying documents.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use `MongoDB.Bson.Serialization.Attributes` to map C# properties to BSON fields.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: The MongoDB Driver enables flexible document database access from .NET.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Perform CRUD operations on a MongoDB collection.
steps: Insert, find, update, and delete documents
data.expectedOutcome: A working MongoDB integration with basic CRUD operations.
